claims.claim_text: 官方宣稱在傳統模型上比其他 web runtime 快最多 3 倍，GPU／NPU 後端相較 CPU 可達 5 到 60 倍。
claims.evidence: "LiteRT.js delivers significant speedups—outperforming other web runtimes by up to 3x across both CPU and GPU inference." / "leveraging the GPU or NPU via WebGPU or WebNN delivers 5-60x speedup compared to standard CPU execution"
claims.note: Both numbers supported; '傳統模型' narrows scope but does not inflate. Backends (WebGPU via ML Drift, experimental WebNN, XNNPACK CPU) confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 底層用 Ceph RBD 的 copy-on-write clone 做分支、Kubernetes 當 control plane、Rook 來編排 Ceph。
claims.evidence: "A clone is a writable RBD image that refers back to that snapshot for data it does not yet own." / "The Rook operator watches those resources and creates or updates the corresponding Ceph daemons"
claims.note: COW RBD clone branching, Kubernetes control plane, Rook-orchestrated Ceph all confirmed; part-1 focus with implementation deferred also stated.

claims.claim_text: start_mining 這個 tool 啟動一段 orchestration，回傳即時結果或一個 workflow_id，再由 get_mining_result 拿該 id 輪詢執行狀態。
claims.evidence: start_mining: "Starts a Durable Functions orchestration... Returns the result inline if completed within budget, or returns a workflow_id if still running"; get_mining_result: "Takes the workflow_id. Returns the current state"
claims.note: Tool names, return semantics, and synchronous-timeout workaround confirmed.

claims.claim_text: Roc 語言團隊把約 30 萬行的 Rust 編譯器整個改寫成 Zig，花了 487 天才追回原本的功能。
claims.evidence: "our 300,000 lines of Rust code into Zig" / "our 487-day rewrite" / "zig build --watch -fincremental can rebuild a change... in about 35 milliseconds"
claims.note: 300k lines, 487-day rewrite, 35ms incremental build all confirmed; lost features (borrow checker, private fields, backward-compat) confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 記憶體損毀類 bug 從 Rust 版的 21 個降到 10 個，不過多半是編譯器產碼的 miscompilation。
claims.evidence: "Bug where memory corruption occurred: Rust 21, Zig 10" / "8 of the 10 memory corruption bugs in the Zig-based compiler were also miscompilations"

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 的 Smart Tiered Cache 現在能吃客戶指定的雲端 region 提示……現在你可以透過 dashboard、API 或 Terraform 指定 region。
claims.evidence: "Smart Tiered Cache for Public Cloud Regions fixes this by letting you provide a cloud region hint." / "the same configuration is available via the API and through Terraform" / "hairpin traffic across continents, adding a whole extra round trip."
claims.note: Region-hint feature, anycast cross-continent problem, dashboard/API/Terraform config confirmed. AWS/GCP/Azure/Oracle list consistent with 'public clouds' framing.

claims.claim_text: 作者用 330 個貢獻節點、花 40 天訓出 86 億參數的 Pluralis-8B（吃 5000 億 token），達到集中式 H100 基線約 63% 的效率。
claims.evidence: "330 contributor nodes" / "Pluralis-8B, an open, permissionless pretraining run of an 8.6B-parameter model on 500B tokens." / "63% of the efficiency of a centralized H100 baseline." / "over 40 days"
claims.note: All numbers confirmed; '花 40 天' vs 'over 40 days' is deflation not inflation. Pipeline-stage / no-full-weights claim supported.

claims.claim_text: 把龐大的單體 system prompt 拆成可重用的 skill 檔，用 template engine 組合並 transpile，好在部署前就用 dependency 驗證與 CI/CD 檢查抓出副作用。
claims.evidence: "treat prompts like build artifacts as opposed to just static text." / "author modular skill files." / "running validation checks for missing imports, undefined variables, and circular dependencies during the build process."
claims.note: Build-artifact framing, skill-file decomposition, template/transpile, dependency + CI/CD validation, ripple-effect problem all confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 外鍵預設不啟用、型別檢查鬆散、一遇寫入競爭就丟 SQLITE_BUSY、WAL 預設關閉……作者提議用像 PRAGMA edition = 2026 的單一開關。
claims.evidence: "The only RDBMS I'm aware of which doesn't enforce this by default is SQLite." / "one of them will immediately receive an SQLITE_BUSY error." / "the most significant bad default is that SQLite's WAL is disabled by default." / "PRAGMA edition = 2026; should be an alias for at least the following set of pragmas"
claims.note: All four defaults and PRAGMA edition = 2026 proposal confirmed; explicitly modeled on Rust editions.

claims.claim_text: 一支 20 條語句、被呼叫 10 萬次的 stored procedure，可能就多送約 200 萬個無用 token……開了之後 ExecuteNonQuery() 會回傳 -1，需要時得自己用 @@ROWCOUNT 補回來。
claims.evidence: "A procedure with 20 statements called 100,000 times could avoid about 2 million unnecessary row-count protocol tokens." / "SqlCommand.ExecuteNonQuery() may receive -1... Return @@ROWCOUNT explicitly when the application requires that value."
claims.note: 2-million-token figure, ExecuteNonQuery() -1 side effect, @@ROWCOUNT remedy all confirmed verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 編譯器只單態化到型別的「GC shape」，所以像 *User 和 *Order 這種指標型別會共用同一份編譯後函式本體……代價是共用本體得在執行期查 dictionary 才能做型別相依操作。
claims.evidence: "It monomorphizes, but only down to a type's GC shape." / "all pointer types share a single shape named after *uint8." / "The compiler rewrites these operations in a dictionary pass so they read what they need from the dictionary at runtime."
claims.note: GC-shape monomorphization, pointer types sharing one body, runtime dictionary lookup for type-dependent ops confirmed. Source example uses *uint8; lede's *User/*Order illustrate the same rule.
